title: DRYAS: detection limits for far-field earthquake signals in tree-ring networks (code, synthetic testbed and pre-registration record)
description: Analysis pipeline (scripts 001-010) for the pre-registered injection-recovery test of the Japanese ITRDB tree-ring array against the USGS earthquake catalogue, including the synthetic testbed with embedded suppressions, the automatically generated pre-registration record, and the derived tables. Tree-ring data are the public ITRDB files hosted by NOAA NCEI (cited by dataset DOI in the paper) and are re-downloaded by script 001.
